description: Use this when the user picked one Phorme program and wants its details. It returns the program, every session of its first week, where to find it in the Phorme app, and a link to a page that describes it. It reads only, shows no prices and starts no purchase.

program_id.description: The program id returned by search_phorme_programs.

name: get_phorme_program

first_week.description: Every session of the first week with its exercises and demo links.
